column2: Mentawai–English and Mentawai–Indonesian Bible glosses, machine-made by word-aligning the Mentawai New Testament (LAI) with 18 English Bibles (ASV, BSB, KJV, ULB, YLT, AMP, ERV, NASB, NKJV, CSB, EASY, ESV, GNT, GW, NET, NIRV, NIV, NLT) and 7 Indonesian ones (TB, AMD2021, BIS, FAYH, PBTB2, TSI, VMD) with eflomal: a Mentawai word's English glosses, then its Indonesian ones, commonest first; an English or Indonesian word finds its Mentawai ones. Unchecked: verify before relying on it.
